description.en: Comb-like pinnate rays spread in a palmate fern frond.
description.zh: 梳状羽裂叶射线展开为掌状蕨叶。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Matonidium, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Matonidium 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Separate pinnate rays form a segmented umbrella, unlike fused Hausmannia or the lobed rays of Dictyophyllum.
distinctness.zh: 独立羽状射线形成分段伞形，区别于愈合Hausmannia或Dictyophyllum裂叶射线。

modeling_brief.en: Use slender radial rachises with paired blocky pinnules; retain open gaps between rays.
modeling_brief.zh: 用细放射叶轴和成对块状小羽片建形，保留射线间空隙。

uncertainty: Detached frond architecture; whole fern and rhizome are not reconstructed.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
